title: Read the Documentation
text:
Read the Documentation. I selected this roasting pan with Thanksgiving turkey in mind. I have a shallow roasting pan that I have used and it does work but it is a nightmare to clean and is so low-profile that I worry about losing what I'm cooking when I am moving it. While I like this pan, the warnings that come with give me pause.

First off, it is very clearly marketed as a steel pan. This is one of the reasons I selected it as I am not too excited about using aluminum (and given the choice, I would use cast iron exclusively). For a steel pan, this one is very lightweight, more so than I could reasonably expect.

One of the big factors for me when when selecting cookware is whether or not it is coated in Teflon. This doesn't look like a Teflon-coated pan, but the warning label hits all the check boxes - keep away from pets and small children while not in use, and it doesn't mean that the pan gets hot and can cause burns. In fact, it spells out the potential for respiratory issues when this pan is being used - a problem with Teflon when it is heated to a certain threshold and beyond. With two cats in the house, there is cause for concern in light of the warnings.

As a large serving pan, though, I have found it to be more than sufficient. The handles make it easy to control and carry, and it's spacious enough to hold a lot.

So, this is not the roasting pan I will be using for Thanksgiving. It seems to be made well enough (though I question the material claims), it is easy to clean and it looks nice. However, the warnings that come with it are enough to make me wary. My search for a better roasting pan continues.

product_metadata.title: Ayesha Curry Nonstick Roaster / Roasting Pan with Rack - 11 Inch x 15 Inch, Brown
features: DURABLE STEEL ROASTER WITH RACK: Heavy-duty, high-performance steel construction boasts extended edges for easy handling in and out of the oven
PERFECTLY COOK VARIOUS CUTS AND SIZES: Convertible roasting rack adjusts to handle roasts and cuts of different sizes or to cook poultry upright
EASY TO CLEAN ROASTING PAN AND RACK: Long-lasting, high-quality nonstick for great food release and easy cleanup
EASY, CONVENIENT CLEANING: Roaster and rack are dishwasher safe for convenient cleaning, hand wash recommended
HIGH HEAT PERFORMANCE BAKEWARE: Dual-riveted stainless steel handles make this roasting pan and convertible rack oven safe to 450 degrees F
description: Roast up family favorites and traditional special-occasion recipes with the Ayesha Bakeware 11-inch x 15-inch Nonstick Roaster with Convertible Rack. This high-quality roaster features enhanced nonstick coating for easy, dependable food release recipe after recipe. Constructed from heavy-duty, high-performance steel, the roasting pan boasts excellent resistance to warping and bending and is formed with extended edges with stainless steel handles for easy control and a distinctive, chic design. The roaster also features an adjustable nonstick roasting rack to handle roasts and cuts of all sizes, with a center spire for standing poultry up to cook on end. Both the roaster and rack are dishwasher-safe but hand-washing is recommended for best performance. Oven safe to 450°F so be sure to grab your oven mitts before grabbing those sturdy handles! From roast beef to turkey to lemon beer chicken, reach for the Ayesha Bakeware Nonstick Roaster with Convertible Rack, 11-inch x 15-inch and bring on the flavors, feasts, and fun.
